tasks.title: Camera–IMU synchronization error
tasks.solution: The error angle θ = ω·δt (in radians), the feature shift ≈ r·θ. For 180 °/s, 5 ms and 3 m: π·0.005 = 0.0157 rad → 4.7 cm.

tasks.title: Unaccounted external navigation latency
tasks.solution: The EKF matches the measurement with the state VISO_DELAY_MS back; the unaccounted part of the latency (tr − tp) gives a mismatch of v·(tr − tp). For 120 ms versus 10 ms (the default) at 5 m/s that is 0.55 m, which with a VISO_POS_M_NSE noise of 0.2 m is already a noticeable share of the gate.
